entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding with VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return something. I bought a helmet a little while ago and... well, I just need to send it back. I'm so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's... it's the color. It just wasn't what I expected from the pictures online. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was really looking forward to it. Now it's just sitting here, a sad reminder. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

I understand completely. Sometimes colors can look a bit different on screen. Getting the right gear is important, especially for something that ensures your safety. Let me just pull up your account. Could I have your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really was counting on getting this money back. Things are a bit tight right now.
Thank you. I've found the order. I see it was delivered about 55 days ago. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item... Okay, I have good news for you.
Yes. The helmet is one of our standard items, which falls under our 10-day return policy. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much, Isaac.

You're very welcome. It's no problem at all. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Since the box is unopened, you can just attach the label to it and drop it off with the carrier. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help. I really appreciate it.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
